strings.step_aside_stow_buttons: {0} is installed: Burrow hides its Quick stack, Store all, Top up and Sort buttons, their hotkeys (including Alt+D) and automatic sorting. Remove {0} to use them.
strings.step_aside_multi_user_chests: {0} is installed: Burrow leaves shared chest use to it and does not open chests another player is using. Remove {0} to use Burrow's multi-user chests.
strings.cfg_0_containers__ships_help: Ship storage counts as a container: crafting, station feeding, quick stacking and every other module may use it.
strings.cfg_0_containers__carts_help: Cart storage counts as a container.
strings.cfg_0_containers__player_chests_help: The Personal Chest (piece_chest_private) counts as a container, for its owner only.
strings.cfg_0_containers__honor_wards_help: Containers inside a ward the player may not use are skipped (the game's PrivateArea.CheckAccess, for containers that check wards).
strings.cfg_0_containers__shared_chests_help: Used only when Multi-User Chests is off (it is on by default, which lets every player use a chest at once). What happens with a chest another player has open. Off: it is skipped, as the game itself refuses to open it. View: interacting with it shows its contents read-only, titled '(in use by <player>)', and the panel turns live when the other player closes it. Full: as View, and every change (click move, drag and drop, take all, stack all, Burrow's own actions) is sent as a request to the player's client that owns the chest, which applies it or refuses it; nothing is applied speculatively.
strings.cfg_0_containers__multi_user_chests_help: Several players can use the same chest at once. A chest another player has open opens for you too, and every change you make is applied by the client that owns the chest, so nothing is duplicated or lost (the same as Shared Chests = Full). Off: the Shared Chests setting decides. Ignored while MultiUserChest is installed. A container another mod marks with the MUC_Ignore flag is never shared.
strings.cfg_1_reach__enabled_help: Master switch of the Reach module: crafting, building and station feeding from nearby containers.
strings.cfg_1_reach__range_help: Meters from the player within which containers are reachable for crafting, building and station feeding. Burrow.Reach.yml may override it per container prefab.
strings.cfg_1_reach__crafting_help: Recipes in the crafting panel, and Epic Loot's enchanting table when it is installed, may consume from containers.
strings.cfg_1_reach__building_help: Pieces placed with the hammer, hoe and cultivator may consume from containers.
strings.cfg_1_reach__upgrading_help: Item upgrades in the crafting panel may consume from containers.
strings.cfg_1_reach__feed_stations_help: Smelters, kilns, blast furnaces, spinning wheels, windmills, fires, torches, hot tubs, cooking stations, ovens and fermenters take ore, fuel, food or base mead from containers when the player interacts with them and carries none.
strings.cfg_1_reach__fill_modifier_help: Held while interacting: fills a station until full or resources run out; aimed at a chest, quick-stacks matching carried items into that chest without opening it.
strings.cfg_1_reach__pull_modifier_help: Held while interacting with a station or clicking Craft: the matching materials are moved into the player's inventory instead of being consumed from containers.
strings.cfg_1_reach__toggle_key_help: Toggles the whole module for this player; the state is remembered per character and shown in the center message.
strings.cfg_1_reach__show_links_help: When a container is placed, lines are drawn from it to every station within range for Link Seconds; also on Link Key.
strings.cfg_1_reach__link_key_help: Draws the lines from every container in range to their stations for Link Seconds.
strings.cfg_1_reach__link_seconds_help: Seconds the link lines stay on screen: the lines from containers to the stations they supply, and the Find Key markers.
strings.cfg_1_reach__requirement_display_help: How a requirement amount is shown when containers hold some: Split "3 + 12", Total "15", Vanilla inventory only.
strings.cfg_1_reach__storage_color_help: Color (hex, #rrggbb) of the amount from containers in the crafting and building panels and of the link lines.
strings.cfg_1_reach__flash_on_pull_help: The requirement rows that were paid from containers flash once after crafting or placing.
strings.cfg_1_reach__station_extension_range_mul: Upgrade tools (anvils, tanning rack, chopping block, adze and the other station extensions) connect to their crafting station this many times farther than in vanilla. 1 is vanilla.
strings.cfg_2_stow__enabled_help: Master switch of the Stow module: panel buttons, hotkeys, sorting, trashing, routing, chest cycling and ground pickup.
strings.cfg_2_stow__quick_stack_key_help: Inventory open: every non-favorite stack whose item already exists in the open container (or, with no container open, in any nearby container) moves there.
strings.cfg_2_stow__quick_stack_nearby_help: Quick stack also reaches every nearby container, not only the open one. Off also disables the Dump key.
strings.cfg_2_stow__store_all_key_help: Inventory open with a container: every non-favorite item moves into the open container as far as it fits.
strings.cfg_2_stow__take_all_key_help: Inventory open with a container: the game's Take all - every stack in the open container moves into your inventory as far as it fits.
strings.cfg_2_stow__top_up_key_help: Inventory open: every stack in the inventory that is not full is topped up from the open container or nearby containers. Favorite items included.
strings.cfg_2_stow__nearby_range_help: Meters from the player for quick stack, top up, dump, route, find and cycle.
strings.cfg_2_stow__sort_inventory_key_help: Inventory open: sorts the player inventory by Sort Order. The hotbar, favorite slots, favorite items, equipped items and the rows other mods add below the game's (Main Inventory Rows) stay where they are.
strings.cfg_2_stow__sort_container_key_help: Inventory open with a container: sorts the open container by Sort Order.
strings.cfg_2_stow__sort_order_help: Category (item type, then name), Name, Weight (heaviest first), Value (most valuable first) or Amount (the item you have the most of first, all its stacks counted together). Stacks of the same item merge while sorting.
strings.cfg_2_stow__main_inventory_rows_help: Rows of the player inventory, hotbar included, that quick stack, store all, dump and sort work on; the hotbar itself is always left alone. 0: the rows the game gives you (4, more once bought from the trader). Mods that add equipment, food or ammo slots keep them in rows below, which these actions leave alone; top up still fills the stacks there. Set a number when a mod adds ordinary inventory rows; 20 covers every row.
strings.cfg_2_stow__auto_sort_containers_help: A container is sorted when it is opened. Does nothing while Quick Stack Store Sort Trash Restock, AzuAutoStore or Simple Sort is installed: Burrow's sort row steps aside with them, and the log says so once.
strings.cfg_2_stow__auto_sort_inventory_help: The player inventory is sorted when the panel opens. Does nothing while Quick Stack Store Sort Trash Restock, AzuAutoStore or Simple Sort is installed: Burrow's sort row steps aside with them, and the log says so once.
strings.cfg_2_stow__favorite_item_key_help: Hovering an item: the item name becomes a favorite (never sorted, quick stacked, stored, dumped, trashed or salvaged). Press again to remove.
strings.cfg_2_stow__favorite_slot_key_help: Hovering a slot of the player inventory: the slot becomes a favorite (its content never moves, never sorted). Press again to remove.
strings.cfg_2_stow__show_favorites_help: Favorite items get a small star in the corner of the slot, favorite slots a colored border, junk a small cross.
strings.cfg_2_stow__junk_key_help: Hovering an item: the item name is marked as junk (never restocked; Destroy Junk destroys every junk stack). Press again to unmark it.
strings.cfg_2_stow__trash_key_help: Hovering an item in the inventory or the open chest: the stack is trashed (after the popup when Confirm Trash is on).
strings.cfg_2_stow__destroy_junk_key_help: Destroys every junk stack in the inventory (after the popup when Confirm Trash is on).
strings.cfg_2_stow__confirm_trash_help: The game's popup asks before anything is destroyed; gamepad confirm and cancel work. Off: trashing is immediate.
strings.cfg_2_stow__trash_uses_salvage_help: Trashing a whole stack from the inventory salvages it instead when Kindle is installed and can salvage the item.
strings.cfg_2_stow__trash_can_on_stat_column_hel: The trash can on its own plate in the game's style under the armor, where trash can mods put theirs. Off, or while Mantle lays out the inventory, it sits at the end of the button row. Shift+click the can for trash mode. Takes effect the next time you enter a world.
strings.cfg_2_stow__feed_source_key_help: With a chest open: toggle its Feed source tag, read by Shepherd's container feeding. Personal Chests cannot be feed sources.
strings.cfg_2_stow__route_modifier_help: Held with a left click on an inventory item: the stack is sent to the nearest nearby container that already holds the item; when none does, to the open container; else to one holding an item of its group or accepting it in Burrow.Stow.yml. What does not fit there goes on to the next nearest container holding the item.
strings.cfg_2_stow__store_one_key_help: On a hovered inventory item: one item of the stack goes to the open container, or to the nearest container holding it; when that one is full, to the next nearest container holding it.
strings.cfg_2_stow__find_key_help: Hovering an item: every nearby container holding it is marked for Link Seconds (the Reach setting) with a line from the player and a floating count.
strings.cfg_2_stow__dump_key_help: Outside the inventory: quick stack to every nearby container.
strings.cfg_2_stow__cycle_previous_key_help: With a container open: closes it and opens the previous nearby container, ordered by angle around the player. Only containers the game would keep open (within its auto close distance) take part.
strings.cfg_2_stow__cycle_next_key_help: With a container open: closes it and opens the next nearby container.
strings.cfg_2_stow__cycle_with_wheel_help: The mouse wheel over the container grid cycles too.
strings.cfg_2_stow__ground_pickup_help: Containers whose prefab has pickup: true in Burrow.Stow.yml pull dropped items from the ground by rule.
strings.cfg_2_stow__pickup_range_help: Radius in meters around a pickup container within which it collects dropped items.
strings.cfg_2_stow__pickup_interval_help: Seconds between sweeps of one container.
strings.cfg_2_stow__pickup_delay_help: Seconds an item must lie on the ground before a container takes it, measured from the item's spawn time, so players can pick up their own drops.
strings.cfg_2_stow__pickup_only_held_items_help: A container only collects items it already holds, plus items its accept list in Burrow.Stow.yml allows. Off: it collects anything its refuse list allows.
strings.cfg_2_stow__auto_tidy_help: Nearby chests sort items out between themselves: an item with no place in its chest (anything in a junk chest of mixed items, or a stray among other things) moves to the nearest chest within 15 m that is its home - one that mostly holds that item or things like it, or held it until it ran out. Chests learn from what players put where by hand, and an item a player puts back after it was moved stays there. Ships, carts and Personal Chests take no part.
strings.cfg_4_stacks__enabled_help: Master switch of the Stacks module. Off: every item keeps its vanilla stack and weight, portals and chest merging are vanilla.
strings.cfg_4_stacks__stack_multiplier_help: Every stackable item's maximum stack is multiplied by this (rounded, at least 1). Items with a vanilla stack of 1 stay 1. Default 4 with Weight Multiplier 0.25: four times the stack, and a full stack weighs what a vanilla full stack weighs (Wood 200 at 0.5 instead of 50 at 2). Burrow.Stacks.yml may replace it.
strings.cfg_4_stacks__weight_multiplier_help: Every stackable item's weight (vanilla stack above 1) is multiplied by this; items with a vanilla stack of 1 (tools, weapons, armor) keep their weight. Default 0.25 goes with Stack Multiplier 4, so a full stack weighs the same as in vanilla. Burrow.Stacks.yml may replace it.
strings.cfg_4_stacks__ignore_teleport_restrictio: The portal check accepts every item.
strings.cfg_4_stacks__merge_into_chests_help: A stack dragged into an open container fills that container's partial stacks of the same item first; the remainder goes to the slot it was dropped on.
strings.cfg_4_stacks__per_item_config_entries_he: Generates one <prefab>.Stack and <prefab>.Weight entry per item into sections 4a and 4b when the item database loads, for Configuration Manager users. 0 or the vanilla value means not set. Burrow.Stacks.yml wins where it names the same item.
strings.cfg_5_capacity__enabled_help: Master switch of the Capacity module: container sizes from Burrow.Containers.yml, station capacities from Burrow.Stations.yml and the hover contents. Off restores the vanilla sizes where no item is in the way and the vanilla station capacities.
strings.cfg_5_capacity__station_minimum_capacity: Smelters, kilns, furnaces, the spinning wheel, windmill, eitr refinery and other processing stations, including stations from other mods, hold at least this many items and this much fuel. A station with its own line in Burrow.Stations.yml uses that line instead (set exact values there); a station the game already gives more keeps its own value, and a slot the station does not use stays unused. 0 keeps the game's capacities. Host setting, applies to everyone. Default: 50.
strings.cfg_5_capacity__hover_contents_help: Hovering a container adds its fill and contents to the hover text: the Hover Fill line, up to Hover Lines lines of 'name x count', then 'and n more'. Only for containers you could open, and only while Chest Preview is off: the preview panel shows the contents otherwise. Off by default: the hover shows the action prompt and the preview panel only.
strings.cfg_5_capacity__hover_lines_help: How many content lines the hover text shows.
strings.cfg_5_capacity__hover_fill_help: The hover text's first extra line: Fraction '12 / 24 slots', Percent '50% full', Off.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__enabled_help: Looking at a container you could open shows a panel with its contents: item icons, names, quality and counts, and the used slots beside its name. Dungeon and world chests are shown too. While the panel shows a chest, the hover text leaves its content lines out.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__toggle_key_help: Turns the chest preview on and off. Unbound by default; the F8 Meadworks menu has the same switch.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__show_item_icons_he: Each row starts with the item's icon.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__show_quality_help: Items above quality 1 show a star and their quality.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__sort_by_help: Value (the stack's worth), Weight (the stack's weight), Name or Amount.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__sort_descending_he: Largest (or Z) first. Off: smallest (or A) first, as Solo lists a chest.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__combine_stacks_hel: Stacks of the same item, quality and variant are shown as one row with their counts added up.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__columns_help: Rows are split over this many columns.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__max_entries_help: At most this many rows, then '+ n more'. 0 shows every row.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__column_width_help: Width of one column of the panel, in interface units.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__position_x_help: The panel's left edge, as a fraction of the screen width.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__position_y_help: The panel's middle, as a fraction of the screen height from the bottom.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__background_alpha_h: Opacity of the panel's background only.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__capacity_format_he: Beside the chest's name: {0} used slots, {1} all slots, {2} percent used. Empty hides it.
strings.cfg_5a_chest_preview__hide_preview_for_e: On: looking at an empty container shows no panel, only the hover prompt. Off (default): the panel shows the empty chest with its name and capacity. Per player (local); the host's settings do not change it.
strings.cfg_8_shared_materials__enabled_help: Let other MeadWorks mods, such as Wildroot planting, take materials from your inventory and nearby chests.
strings.cfg_8_shared_materials__player_inventory: Use the player's inventory before nearby chests.
strings.cfg_8_shared_materials__nearby_chests_he: Use permitted, loaded chests that can be owned without interrupting another player.
strings.cfg_8_shared_materials__radius_help: Nearby shared material range in meters.
strings.cfg_9_shared__transfer_radius_help: Maximum authenticated player distance in meters for a new shared chest transfer.
strings.cfg_9_shared__request_timeout_help: Seconds to wait for an answer from the player whose game currently controls a shared chest, before the center message says 'The chest did not answer'. The transfer is not canceled: the items stay held, and the transfer finishes when the answer arrives later.
strings.cfg_9_shared__touch_seconds_help: Seconds a slot stays marked after another player pressed the mouse on it, unless the player lets go earlier.
strings.cfg_9_shared__show_touches_help: Slots another player is moving are tinted and the tooltip says who.
strings.cfg_9_shared__touch_color_help: Color (hex, #rrggbb) of a slot another player is moving.
strings.cfg_general__lock_configuration_help: Server administrators control shared storage settings.
strings.cfg_general__hotkey_defaults_version_hel: Records that Burrow's hotkey defaults update ran for this player. Managed by Burrow.
strings.cfg_general__setting_defaults_version_he: Records that Burrow's changed setting defaults were applied for this player. Managed by Burrow.
strings.trash_mode_destroy_tip: Stacks you trash are destroyed. Drag a stack onto the can, or Shift + click the can and click stacks. Favorites are never trashed.
strings.trash_mode_salvage_tip: Trash Uses Salvage is on: a whole stack of gear from your inventory that Kindle can salvage is salvaged; anything else is destroyed. Drag a stack onto the can, or Shift + click the can and click stacks. Favorites are never trashed or salvaged.
strings.trash_favorite_refused: {0} is a favorite and was not trashed
